invented.quote: I took the game to two conventions and put it in front of strangers.
invented.why: The brief states the designer took the game to two conventions, but does not say they put it in front of strangers.

invented.quote: On BoardGameGeek, 23 people have rated it, and their average is 8.1 out of 10.
invented.why: The brief only refers to 'the main board game ratings site' and does not name BoardGameGeek or specify that the rating scale is out of 10.

invented.quote: What those numbers do show is that people who sit down with this game, including people who've never met me, want to play it again.
invented.why: The brief does not state that playtesters or raters were people who had never met the designer or that they wanted to play the game again.

invented.quote: Each of those 140 sessions changed something.
invented.why: The brief states that 140 playtest sessions were run, but does not say that every session resulted in a change to the game.

invented.quote: If we don't reach $28,000, the game doesn't get printed and no one is charged.
invented.why: The brief does not specify which crowdfunding platform is being used or that the campaign uses an all-or-nothing funding model where backers are not charged if the goal is not met.
